module_summary: Wishbone clock-domain crossing bridge: requests are pushed into an async request FIFO and replayed as a master on the second clock, with returns crossing back through an async ack FIFO and abort/reset synchronizers.

anchors.name: i_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Upstream bus cycle; dropping it aborts and clears outstanding counters

anchors.name: i_wb_stb
anchors.why: Upstream request strobe writing a request into reqfifo

anchors.name: i_wb_we
anchors.why: Read/write command carried through request FIFO

anchors.name: i_wb_addr
anchors.why: Upstream request address pushed into reqfifo

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Upstream write data pushed into reqfifo

anchors.name: o_wb_stall
anchors.why: Stall when ack count full, aborting, or request FIFO full

anchors.name: o_wb_ack
anchors.why: Upstream ack from ack FIFO output, decrements outstanding count

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Returned read data from ack FIFO

anchors.name: o_wb_err
anchors.why: Upstream bus error; triggers bus_abort and counter clear

anchors.name: o_xclk_cyc
anchors.why: Downstream cycle line from FIFO strobe/drop-cycle entries

anchors.name: o_xclk_stb
anchors.why: Downstream request strobe replaying FIFO requests

anchors.name: o_xclk_we
anchors.why: Downstream write enable from FIFO

anchors.name: o_xclk_addr
anchors.why: Downstream address registered from request FIFO

anchors.name: o_xclk_data
anchors.why: Downstream write data registered from request FIFO

anchors.name: o_xclk_sel
anchors.why: Downstream byte selects from request FIFO

anchors.name: i_xclk_stall
anchors.why: Downstream stall gating FIFO reads and strobe

anchors.name: i_xclk_ack
anchors.why: Downstream ack written into ack FIFO

anchors.name: i_xclk_data
anchors.why: Downstream read data written into ack FIFO

anchors.name: i_xclk_err
anchors.why: Downstream error setting xclk_err_state and dropping cycle

anchors.name: wb_active
anchors.why: Marks active upstream cycle, pushes drop-cycle entry when cyc falls

anchors.name: acks_outstanding
anchors.why: Counts requests awaiting acks on upstream clock

anchors.name: ackfifo_empty
anchors.why: No outstanding acks; releases bus_abort pipeline

anchors.name: ackfifo_full
anchors.why: Outstanding count full, stalls upstream

anchors.name: xclk_err_state
anchors.why: Downstream error state suppressing cyc/stb until cycle restarts

anchors.name: req_stb
anchors.why: FIFO entry type: strobe request vs drop-cycle marker

anchors.name: req_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Request FIFO empty gating downstream issue

anchors.name: no_returns
anchors.why: Ack FIFO empty; gates reads and upstream ack

groups.name: Upstream request intake
groups.description: Upstream Wishbone slave pushing requests into async request FIFO

groups.name: Downstream master
groups.description: Replays FIFO requests as Wishbone master on the second clock

groups.name: Return path
groups.description: Async ack FIFO carrying acks, errors and data back upstream

groups.name: Outstanding ack counter
groups.description: Tracks outstanding requests for stall and abort control
